name: io.github.MistaKilla/sub-family
title: Sub-Family
description: Delegate work to local and cloud LLMs over MCP with sessions, swarms and privacy tiers.

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: DeepSeek API key used by the default 'big_brother' cloud member. Required by the family.yaml generated by 'sub-family init'; omit only with a custom config that does not use DeepSeek.

environmentVariables.name: SUB_FAMILY_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to family.yaml. Defaults to the platform config directory: ~/.config/sub-family/family.yaml on POSIX, %APPDATA%\sub-family\family.yaml on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: SUB_FAMILY_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory containing family.yaml and its optional .env file. Overrides the default platform config directory when SUB_FAMILY_CONFIG is not set.

environmentVariables.name: SUB_FAMILY_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for mutable state such as the sessions.db SQLite database. Defaults to ~/.local/share/sub-family on POSIX or %LOCALAPPDATA%\sub-family on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: SUB_FAMILY_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity written to stderr (stdout is reserved for the MCP JSON-RPC stream).
